title: Toilet rooms.
officialText:
Toilet rooms shall not open directly into a room used for the preparation of food for service to the public. In
multiple dwellings no toilet room or bathroom shall open onto any kitchen or kitchenette.
SECTION BC 1211
KITCHENS AND KITCHENETTES
